artworks.title: Danaë
artworks.description: Titian's Prado Danaë receives Zeus as a rain of gold while a maid gathers coins — the impregnation that fathers Perseus before Acrisius' chest and the Seriphos landfall.

artworks.title: Danaë
artworks.description: Rembrandt's Hermitage Danaë waits in shadowed light as Zeus' golden visitation arrives — the bronze-tower conception that opens the Seriphos birth saga.

artworks.title: Danaë
artworks.description: Artemisia paints Danaë and a servant under the golden rain — Zeus' visit as charged exchange before the infant and the sea-chest.

artworks.title: Danaë and Perseus on Seriphos
artworks.description: Fuseli's Yale canvas: the chest washes onto Seriphos — Danaë and the infant Perseus delivered from Acrisius' sea sentence to Dictys' shore.

artworks.title: Danaë Arriving at Seriphos with the Infant Perseus
artworks.artist: Pompeian workshop (House of the Greek Epigrams)
artworks.description: Roman fresco: Danaë cradles baby Perseus as their drifting chest reaches Seriphos — the ancient landfall that begins the island childhood.

films.title: Clash of the Titans
films.description: Harryhausen's Perseus opens with Danae's chest and the Seriphos court — the bronze tower and golden shower retold as stop-motion myth.

popCulture.title: Danaë
popCulture.description: The princess shut in bronze, visited by Zeus as gold, cast to sea with her infant — Seriphos begins where Acrisius' fear ends.

popCulture.title: Perseus
popCulture.description: The chest-born hero reared by Dictys on Seriphos — Athena's favorite whose birth already holds the oracle that will kill Acrisius.

popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Ovid retells the shower of gold and the floating chest — Danae and Perseus as metamorphosis before the Gorgon's head.
